verdict.rationale: Paystack documents a public API at paystack.com/docs/api that lets you programmatically do the same operations available in the Dashboard. The docs cover test and live API keys, copy-paste cURL examples, pagination metadata on list endpoints, and diagnostic error metadata, so an AI-native user can drive the product through it. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in agentic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Paystack API lets you programmatically collect payments, manage transactions, and perform other operations that you can also do from your Paystack Dashboard.
You can copy and paste these examples into your own code or run them from the command line using cURL.
This works for both test and live environments. Your API keys determine which environment you're using.
When a request fails, the meta object contains diagnostic information that can help you debug the issue.
